description_en: Creates a data report export task
description_zh: 创建数据报表导出任务
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ecd-report-task --business-channel example-string --task-type RESOURCE_REPORT --sub-type DESKTOP --filter-list '[{"FilterValues":["测试云电脑名称"],"FilterKey":"Tag:TestKey"}]' --report-file-name Test_report_name --lang-type zh-CN --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEcdReportTask

parameters.help_zh:

Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en:
The type of the report task.

Valid value:

- RESOURCE\_REPORT
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The sub-type of the report export task
parameters.name: sub_type

element_fields.help_en:
The key of the filter condition for filtering query results. When SubType is set to:

1. DESKTOP (indicating a cloud computer report), the following filter conditions are available:

- KeyWord: cloud computer keyword (supports automatic recognition)

- RegionId: region ID

- DesktopId: cloud computer ID

- DesktopName: cloud computer name (supports fuzzy matching)

- OfficeSiteId: office network ID

- OfficeSiteName: office network name (supports fuzzy matching)

- Status: cloud computer status

- DesktopType: desktop type

- DesktopIP: cloud computer IP address

- SubPayType: billing method

- EndUserId: user name (supports fuzzy matching)

- ExpireTime: expiration date and time, in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format

- IncludeAssignedUser: indicates whether the cloud computer is assigned to users or not

- ResourceGroupId: resource group ID

- PolicyId: policy ID

- Tag:{Tag Key value}: cloud computer tag (To filter data using multiple tags, specify multiple filter condition objects.)
element_fields.help_zh:
报表查询过滤条件，根据SubType不同：
1. 云电脑报表
- KeyWord  云电脑关键字自动识别
- RegionId  地域ID
- DesktopId  云电脑ID
- DesktopName  云电脑名称（模糊搜索）
- OfficeSiteId  办公网络ID
- OfficeSiteName  办公网络名称（模糊搜索）
- Status  云电脑状态
- DesktopType  桌面规格
- DesktopIP  云电脑IP
- SubPayType  购买方式
- EndUserId  用户名称（模糊搜索）
- ExpireTime  过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
- IncludeAssignedUser  是否分配用户
- ResourceGroupId  资源组ID
- PolicyId  策略ID
- Tag:{标签Key值}  云电脑标签（多标签查询时，传入多个Filter对象）
element_fields.name: filter_key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition. Only the first value of the FilterValues parameter is used, if FilterKey is set to one of the following values:

- KeyWord

- DesktopName

- OfficeSiteName

- DesktopIP

- EndUserId

- ExpireTime

- IncludeAssignedUser
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。
当FilterKey是以下取值时，FIlterValues入参只取第一个值：
- KeyWord
- DesktopName
- OfficeSiteName
- DesktopIP
- EndUserId
- ExpireTime
- IncludeAssignedUser
element_fields.name: filter_values

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for filtering query results. The logical relationship between each filter condition is "and" (&). Each filter condition contains FilterKey and FilterValues, which indicate the key and value for the filter condition
parameters.help_zh:

每个查询条件包含FilterKey、FilterValues，表示查询条件名称和具体取值
